properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8 v9 v10

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MU biro-eby'empewo
E Beesirekemu;
Muwala omulongoofu
Yazaala-Omwana we.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Musanyuke mwenna
Muyimbe-ettendo lye;
Mujaguze, mujaguze,
Yesu azaaliddwa.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yesu azaaliddwa,
Mu kisa kye-ekingi
Eggye erya bamalayika
Batendereza nnyo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Abasumba bazze
-Okusinza Omwana-oyo;
Abalaguzi batona,
Mugavu ne zaabu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ne bamalayika
Baase-okulamusa
Omwana-oyo mu kisibo
Ye Mukama waffe.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Azze n'okwagala,
-Okuleeta-omukisa;
Eri abantu be bonna,
Atuyigirize.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Oli mu kiraalo
Ggwe-eyava mu ggulu,
Amaggwa galifumita
Ekyenyi kyo, Yesu.

verse.name: v10
verse.lines:
Ka tumuweereze
Nga bamalayika;
Kale tusanyuke fenna
Azaaliddwa leero
